intro.text: Karata's daughter, who lives with her father in the guards' quarters of King Iadon's palace.

items.text: When the Shaod took Karata, nobody told Opais what had become of her mother. She went on living with her father in the guards' quarters of the palace in Kae.

Karata tried three times to slip out of Elantris and find her, and was caught each time. In return for leaving his people alone, Raoden got Karata into the palace, where she left a letter explaining everything, along with a necklace she had smuggled in, beside the sleeping Opais.
